notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has "Super Smash Bros. Ultimate" at completion stage 1 with 32 subpages. Its Walkthrough subpage is short (about 1,250 characters) and works as a fighter index: it links 86 fighter pages, of which 27 are written. Classic Mode (about 59,700 characters), Spirits, Controls and the Table of Contents are also written; Challenges and Gameplay are linked but not written. Because the walkthrough is a roster rather than chapter pages, it was not recorded in sw-structure.json and swUsed is off; only page names (Controls, Classic Mode, Spirits, Challenges) were used to name chapters. supersmashbros.fandom.com has the page with about 462 linked pages; "World of Light" and "Fighters Pass" are taken from that list. Names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG lists Nintendo, Bandai Namco Entertainment and Sora as developers.
